description: From the terrace beside the Monastery of Panagia Paleokastritsa, the whitewashed buildings and a small bell gable sit among cypress on a rocky cape. Two turquoise coves open below, split by a pine headland, with a few small boats at anchor. The sky is clear, about 16.6°C. The sun is on the horizon. The bays are unlit.
